in_game_description: Signatures are unique identification codes that store biometric data, political slants and the Spacenet surfing behaviour of the respective pilot. Data privacy experts are critical towards their application and warn against abuse. Spies can take advantage of this security gap to act behind enemy lines without revealing their identity.
mechanics_text: Equipping a Signature makes that faction treat you as friendly; opposing factions become hostile.
Only one signature can be equipped at a time.
Signature becomes invalid if you attack the faction whose signature you're wearing.
Can be obtained by destroying ships of the target faction.
Or purchased for ~500,000 credits in the Loma system.
Signatures not available for Pirates, Voids, Deep Science, or Valkyrie factions.
Selling price is ~7,500 credits (black market item, sold almost anywhere).
Glitch: can retain signature while attacking friendly if Yin Co. Shadow Ninja cloak is active.
version_notes: Shared page with all 4 Signature variants (Terran, Vossk, Nivelian, Midorian). No infobox stats on wiki page — purely mechanical/behavioral item.
